source.name: Purchase Requisition and Approvals for Business Central

mapping.summary: Purchase requests with budget checks, multi-level approval, vendor quote comparison and PO creation.
claims: Requests cover items, services and fixed assets
Requests capture quantity, estimated price, preferred vendor, justification, priority, needed-by date, department and location
Approvers see request value, remaining department budget and whether it fits
Multi-stage approvals with limits, delegation and comments
Every approval action is logged on the requisition
Single approval queue showing pending and overdue items and average response time
Records vendor quote line prices, validity dates and lead times for comparison
Lines can be awarded to different vendors
Creates a separate purchase order per awarded vendor
Links requisition, approvals, quotes and resulting PO for audit
Procurement role centre with open, pending and overdue requests and monthly volumes
Spend analysis by department and vendor, approval turnaround, conversion rate and RFQ savings
Works across multiple companies with per-company setup
